newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 RISES AT FIXING LED BY BLUE CHIPS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 RISES AT FIXING LED BY BLUE CHIPS.

text.p: Czech shares were mainly up at Wednesday's price fixing on the Prague bourse with telecommunications transmission firm Ceske Radiokomunikace leading the gainers with a 71 crown rise to 4,191.
On Tuesday, TeleDanmark said it had bought a 21 percent stake in the Czech company leaving a further 70 percent in state hands.
Analysts describe Radiokomunikace as a logical competitior to SPT Teleocm when that company's monopoly ends in the year 2000.
Elsewhere, SPT was the only major issue to lose ground. It fell 10 crowns to 4,330.
Komercni Banka rose 43 crowns to 2,038, CEZ was up seven crowns to 945, and Ceska Sporitelna rose four crowns to 280.
